svg.aria-label: Typeahead engine. A consistent-hash ring drawn as a running track with three Redis nodes; the trie sits in the infield. About 6.5 ms p95.

g.text: Python · FastAPI · Redis × 3 · SQLite · Docker Compose
A trie keeps the top ten at every node. A hand-written
consistent-hash ring sends each prefix to one of three Redis
nodes. A batch writer folds thousands of searches into a few
SQLite transactions, and trending blends all-time counts with
Ring, trie and batch writer are hand-written, so every decision is explainable.
add or remove a node: only ~1/N keys move
